description: This class includes the manufacture of clay building materials such as bricks, roofing tiles and other clay construction products.
includes: manufacture of non-refractory ceramic constructional products: clay building bricks, flooring blocks, support or filler tiles and similar products
manufacture of roofing tiles, chimney pots, cowls, chimney liners, architectural ornaments and other clay building products
manufacture of pipes, conduits, guttering and pipe fittings of clay
excludes: manufacture of refractory ceramic products, see 2391
manufacture of ceramic floor and wall tiles, see 2393
